results.title: Michalis Kamburelis | PasDoc
results.snippet: Free Pascal code documenter, fpdoc, is a program distributed and developed as part of FreePascal. It’s goal is similar to pasdoc: parse Pascal units and generate documentation for them. But, unlike pasdoc, fpdoc does not read descriptions of items from the comments placed in unit’s source file.

results.title: PasDoc | Documentation tool for Pascal source code
results.snippet: PasDoc is a documentation tool for the Object Pascal code (as implemented by FPC and Delphi). Documentation is generated from comments found in the source code or in special "description files".
